name: CloakPilot – Affiliate Control Platform: Link Manager, Link Cloaking & Click Tracking
author: cloakpilot

sections.description:
CloakPilot is the Affiliate Control Platform for WordPress. It keeps every affiliate link you earn from in one place, inside your own site.

Each link gets a short, readable address on your own domain, such as example.com/go/your-tool. When a program changes its URL, you edit it once in CloakPilot and every post, page and menu that uses the link follows. Every click is counted on your own server and stays in your WordPress database.

It is built for content sites, review blogs and agencies that earn from other companies’ affiliate programs.

Why publishers use CloakPilot

  • Fix a link once. A changed or expired affiliate URL is one edit, not a hunt through hundreds of posts.
  • See what gets clicked. Reports show which links, vendors and posts get clicks, from which countries and on which devices.
  • Your data stays on your site. Links and clicks live in your own WordPress database. No outside dashboard, and no IP address is stored with a click.
  • Switch without breaking posts. Import from ThirstyAffiliates, Pretty Links, Lasso or a CSV file with a preview first. The old addresses keep working.

Everything in the free version

  • Short /go/ links. A clean address under a prefix you choose (default go), with a 301, 302 or 307 redirect and rel="sponsored nofollow" per link. Redirects are answered from a cached map.
  • Click tracking. Each click is recorded with the source post, the visitor’s country (from your host’s or CDN’s country header) and the device type. Known bots are not recorded, and no third-party tracking service is involved.
  • Auto-linking. Give a link one or more keywords and CloakPilot turns the first mention in a post into the tracked link. It skips headings, existing links, images, quotes and code, and respects a per-post limit.
  • Vendors and categories. Links are grouped by the company that pays you and by your own categories, with notes and the vendor’s dashboard address one click away.
  • Where each link appears. CloakPilot scans your published content and shows, for every link, the pages that contain it.
  • Reports. Clicks by day, by link, by source post, by vendor, by country and by device, for any date range, plus a dashboard widget.
  • Import and export. Bring links in from ThirstyAffiliates, Pretty Links, Lasso or a CSV file, with a preview before anything is written. Export all links to a CSV file, edit them in a spreadsheet and import them back.
  • GA4 events (optional). Send a server-side affiliate_click event to your own Google Analytics 4 property when you enter its Measurement ID and API secret.
  • REST API. Links, categories, vendors, click statistics and settings under cloakpilot/v1, authenticated with standard WordPress Application Passwords.
  • Light and dark interface. One button in the top bar switches the CloakPilot screens between light and dark.
  • Translation-ready, right-to-left included. The interface works in Hebrew and Arabic as well as left-to-right languages, and its own language setting can differ from the site’s. Translations come from translate.wordpress.org.

All of this is free, with no account, no card and no time limit.

Moving from another link plugin

The Import screen finds the links of ThirstyAffiliates, Pretty Links and Lasso on your site and brings in their links, addresses and categories. Click history stays in the old plugin. Step-by-step guides: https://cloakpilot.net/migrate-from-pretty-links, https://cloakpilot.net/migrate-from-thirstyaffiliates and https://cloakpilot.net/migrate-from-lasso

Full version

The full version of CloakPilot is a separate download from https://cloakpilot.net/download, and downloading it is free. Register it for free with your email address to get one AI agent, three products, one campaign and 14 days of everything, no card.

Paid plans add:

  • Products: one address that sends each reader to the right vendor by country, or splits traffic between vendors.
  • Link health: every link is checked every week.
  • Revenue: earnings typed in or pulled from Impact, Post Affiliate Pro and PartnerStack, with earnings per click and conversions.
  • Money on the table: the posts that mention a product you have a link for but do not link it.
  • Campaigns (beta) and blocks: deal cards you design once and place in posts, and four editor blocks.
  • AI agents: as many as you need, each with its own key, only the permissions you choose and an activity log.

Every paid plan starts with a 14-day trial, no card. Plans and prices: https://cloakpilot.net/pricing

None of that code is included in this plugin. To switch, upload the full version under Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin and choose “Replace current with uploaded”; Settings > License in this plugin shows each step. Your links, clicks and settings stay as they are.

External services

CloakPilot works without any external service. It can connect to the following services, each only in the situation described.

Freemius (licensing and the optional usage opt-in). CloakPilot uses the Freemius SDK to offer the optional opt-in, the free trial and paid plans. On first activation Freemius shows its own screen asking whether you agree to share basic information. Only if you click “Allow & Continue”, the details listed on that screen are sent to Freemius (api.freemius.com): your name and email address, the site address and title, the WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, the site language and, where the screen lists it, the names and versions of your plugins and themes. Freemius uses them to manage your account, send license and security notices and, if you start a trial or buy a plan, deliver the paid version. You can opt out later from the Plugins screen. If you skip, nothing is sent and every feature of this plugin keeps working. Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ – Privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

cloakpilot.net (only when you send feedback). The “Send feedback” button on CloakPilot screens opens a form. Nothing is sent until you click Send. Then your server sends the type of feedback, your message and the reply email if you enter one to https://cloakpilot.net/api/feedback, so we can read and answer it. Your site address, the CloakPilot, WordPress and PHP versions, the current CloakPilot screen and the interface and site languages are added only if you tick “Also send these technical details” in the form; the box is off by default and the form lists exactly what it adds. No link, click or license data is ever sent. Terms: https://cloakpilot.net/legal-terms – Privacy policy: https://cloakpilot.net/legal-privacy

Google Analytics 4 (only if you turn it on). If you enter a GA4 Measurement ID and API secret under Settings > GA4, each click on a short link (bots excluded) sends an affiliate_click event from your server to Google’s Measurement Protocol at https://www.google-analytics.com/mp/collect. The event carries the link’s slug and ID, a click identifier, the visitor’s country code (from your host’s country header), the referring page and a client identifier that is a one-way checksum of the visitor’s IP address and browser string; the IP address itself is not sent. The “Test connection” button sends one test event to Google’s validation endpoint. Terms: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/ – Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Nothing else leaves your site: CloakPilot makes no request of its own when it is activated or when you open its screens. The font used for the product name in the admin header (Bricolage Grotesque, SIL Open Font License 1.1) is bundled with the plugin and loaded from your own site.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin go to Plugins > Add New, search for “CloakPilot”, then click Install and Activate. Or upload the plugin zip through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Open CloakPilot in the admin menu. A short setup wizard confirms your link prefix and offers to import existing links.
  3. If you are moving from another link plugin, run the importer as a dry run first and compare a few destinations before you deactivate the old plugin.
  4. If your site uses a page cache, clear it once after activation so the new short links are picked up.
sections.faq:
Is CloakPilot free?

Yes. Everything under “Everything in the free version” is free, with no account, no card and no time limit. The paid plans belong to the full version, which is a separate download.

Can I change the /go/ prefix?

Yes, under CloakPilot > Settings > Redirects. CloakPilot updates the prefix in your published posts and pages and keeps the previous prefix redirecting, so links that are already out in newsletters or on other sites keep working.

Does CloakPilot slow down my site?

Redirects are resolved from a single cached map, without querying each link on every click. Click recording is one database insert. Auto-linking caches its keyword list and runs only on singular posts.

Where is my data stored?

In your own WordPress database. Links, clicks, categories and vendors never leave your site unless you connect a script to the REST API yourself. See “External services” below for the few connections the plugin can make.

Does it work with the block editor?

Yes. The short links are ordinary links, so they work in any block, in the classic editor, in page builders and in menus. The [cloakpilot_cta slug="your-link" text="Buy now"] shortcode prints a tracked link anywhere shortcodes run.

Can AI apps work with my links?

AI agents and the MCP server are part of the full version of CloakPilot, which is free to download from https://cloakpilot.net/download. Registering the full version for free (with an email address or an activation code) gives you one AI agent. This plugin contains no AI-agent code; its Settings > AI agents tab explains where to get them.

How do I move from Pretty Links, ThirstyAffiliates or Lasso?

Open the Import screen in CloakPilot. It finds the links of those plugins on your site and imports their links, addresses and categories, with a dry run first so you see what will happen before anything is written. Click history is not copied; it stays in the old plugin. Lasso Lite is not covered by the Lasso importer. Step-by-step guides: https://cloakpilot.net/migrate-from-pretty-links, https://cloakpilot.net/migrate-from-thirstyaffiliates and https://cloakpilot.net/migrate-from-lasso

Does CloakPilot store visitors’ IP addresses?

No. A click is stored with the link, the time, the post it came from, the referring page, the visitor’s country (from your host’s or CDN’s country header) and the device type. No IP address and no user agent is saved with the click, and known bots are not recorded at all. Two narrow uses, stated for completeness: the public view counter keeps a one-way hash of the address for one minute to limit abuse, and if you turn on the optional GA4 events, each event carries an ID derived from the address and browser, never the address itself.

What happens to my data if I uninstall the plugin?

By default your links, clicks and settings stay in the database, so reinstalling brings everything back. A setting under Settings > Privacy removes all CloakPilot data when the plugin is deleted.

What is the difference between this plugin and the paid version?

This plugin is complete on its own for managing and tracking links. The full version is a different download that adds the features listed under “Full version”. You can switch at any time; your links and clicks stay as they are.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Settings > License shows how to switch to the full version in four steps, with links to the download, the WordPress upload screen and the prices. Every “upgrade” button of this plugin leads there.
  • Switching to the full version keeps your links, clicks and settings, also when the full version is installed in its own folder.
  • New FAQ answers: moving from Pretty Links, ThirstyAffiliates or Lasso, and IP addresses.

1.0.4

  • Side menu: on a site connected to a CloakPilot account, the menu keeps the same order as the top bar. Until now it could come back in a different order.
  • Link addresses in Hebrew and other non-Latin scripts are shown in their own letters everywhere, instead of percent codes. Existing addresses and shortcodes keep working.
  • Revenues: the month total includes additions for single links, so it matches Reports. A script error on this screen is fixed.
  • Money on the table: a link readers click from your posts is no longer listed as “nobody sees them”.
  • CSV import: a destination that is not a web address is reported as an error. A new option updates links that already exist instead of skipping them.
  • Deals: switching tabs no longer saves the deal, and after saving or removing a card the cards window opens again.
  • Saving a link, product or vendor shows a confirmation, and moving an item to the trash offers Undo.
  • Dropdowns work with the keyboard: the arrows move, Enter picks the highlighted option, Home and End jump.
  • Readable top navigation, one font on every screen, long names wrap inside their table column, and on phones the navigation scrolls to the current section.

1.0.3

  • First release on WordPress.org.
  • Short /go/ links with 301, 302 or 307 redirects, click tracking with bot filtering, auto-linking, vendors, categories, link positions, reports, ThirstyAffiliates and CSV import, optional GA4 events and a REST API.
  • Send feedback: the site address and version numbers are sent only if you tick the new “Also send these technical details” box (off by default).
  • The admin header font is bundled with the plugin; no request to an outside font service.
  • Scripts and styles load through the WordPress script and style queues; every request value is sanitized and every output escaped; translation files are served by translate.wordpress.org.
  • AI agents and the MCP server are part of the full version (free download from cloakpilot.net; one agent with a free registration), not of this plugin.
  • Vendors: the “Merge into” and “Move links” dialogs show the vendor that is actually selected.
  • No PHP warning when an item is moved to the trash or restored.
  • Links: the “Assign vendor” window shows the link’s current vendor instead of always showing “Automatic”.
  • Settings: the theme field follows the light/dark button in the top bar.

screenshots.caption: The Links screen: every affiliate link with its /go/ address, destination, vendor, category, clicks and the pages it appears on, with search, filters and bulk actions.
Editing a link: its /go/ address and destination, redirect type, sponsored/nofollow, auto-link keywords, the pages that contain it and its 30-day click trend.
Reports: clicks over any date range, by country, device and vendor, with views by day, by link and by source post.
